title: [BUG] Is `CLAUDE.local.md` deprecated or not?
body: ``` $ claude --version 1.0.31 (Claude Code) ``` Which one of these is true? - *`CLAUDE.local.md` is deprecated* > There are 2 instances of the string `deprecated` on [this Claude Code documentation page](https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/claude-code/memory#claude-md-imports) in reference to `CLAUDE.local.md` - *`CLAUDE.local.md` is not deprecated* > Type `/memory` and see that it is a part of claude code.
author: startakovsky
